question: When the litmus solution is neither acidic nor basic, its colour is _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**purple.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Litmus solution** is an indicator that **changes color** in response to the **pH leve**l of a substance.
 
• When the litmus solution is **neutral,** meaning it has a **pH of 7,** its color is **purple.**
 
• If the litmus solution turns **red**, it indicates that the substance is** acidic **with a **pH below 7.**
 
• If the litmus solution turns **blue**, it indicates that the substance is **basic **with a **pH above 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Litmus paper **is another form of **litmus indicator** that is commonly used in laboratories and classrooms.
 
• **Red litmus paper** turns **blue in basic solutions** and **blue litmus paper turns red** in acidic solutions.
 
• **Purple litmus paper **is used to test for **neutral substances **and does not change color in either acidic or basic solutions.
